$comment: Placeholders that remain in RENDERED chart output, each with an owner and a reason (audit-rendered-chart-placeholders.ts). The measured case it exists for - Forgejo's `git.example.com` - is FIXED and absent. A finding not listed fails; an entry that no longer renders fails as STALE.

entries.reason: the dapr chart ships `replaceme` as the conversion-webhook namespace of its subscriptions CRD - its own template marker. Dapr's operator is designed to patch CRD conversion settings at runtime (upstream behaviour, NOT verified on this tree). Baselined, owned, and not ours to rewrite: the CRD is vendored by the chart.

192.0.2.250 is GitLab's DELIBERATE 'no LoadBalancer range was resolved' sentinel (applications/gitlab/Application.yaml): an RFC 5737 documentation address no network can route. It propagates into every rendered config of the UNSET state; the installer-resolved range's last address replaces it (Job gitlab-lan-address).

`gitlab.invalid` is GitLab's DELIBERATE never-resolves sentinel for names this install neither runs nor exposes (pages, minio, the e-mail sender domain; applications/gitlab/Application.yaml global.hosts.domain). It is the chart's ASSEMBLED name, never a value a client dials.
